src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer (Sainik Welfare Service)
s: On which day of the year is International Yoga Day celebrated?
x: International Yoga Day is on 21 June (summer solstice), declared by the UN on 11 December 2014 and first observed in 2015; the 12th edition (2026) was themed "Yoga for Healthy Ageing" with the main event in Kolkata.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer Screening Test General Studies
s: Van Mahotsav festival in India is celebrated during
x: Van Mahotsav, the tree-planting festival started in 1950 by K.M. Munshi, is held in the first week of July (1–7 July; 77th edition in 2026), at the onset of the monsoon.

src: AP High Court Common Test for Multiple Posts 2026
s: What was the theme of World Humanitarian Day 2025?
o: Strengthening Global Solidarity and Empowering Local Communities
Advancing Technology for Humanity and Society
x:
Most CA books / exam keys: "Strengthening Global Solidarity and Empowering Local Communities". Strictly: the UN's own 2025 campaign was #ActForHumanity and UN pages do not use that phrase (ungeneva.org WHD 2025 page).
Indian current-affairs sources give the 2025 World Humanitarian Day (19 August) theme as "Strengthening Global Solidarity and Empowering Local Communities"; the other options are generic slogans of no 19 August observance. The UN/OCHA campaign itself ran under the hashtag #ActForHumanity.

s: Public service broadcasting day is observed on
x: Public Service Broadcasting Day (Jan Prasaran Diwas, declared 2000) is on 12 November: on 12 November 1947 Gandhi made his only visit to All India Radio, at Broadcasting House, Delhi (not Bombay), and addressed Partition refugees at the Kurukshetra camp.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud
s: Who inaugurated North East Conclave, 2025 at the campus of IIM Shillong in Meghalaya?
x: Union Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister Nirmala Sitharaman inaugurated the IICA North East Conclave 2025 at IIM Shillong (11–12 July 2025), with Meghalaya CM Conrad Sangma present, and laid the foundation stone of IICA's North-East campus; it was organised by the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (Ministry of Corporate Affairs), not by the PM, Home Minister or President.

s: International Women's Day is celebrated on:
x: International Women's Day is observed every year on 8 March to celebrate women's achievements and push for gender equality; the UN recognised it in 1977. 8 July, 8 December and 8 October are not linked to it.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer (Sainik Welfare Service)
s: What is the use of INDRA app?
x: INDRA (Indian Naval Dynamic Resource for Weather Analysis), built by BISAG-N with the Navy's Directorate of Naval Oceanology and Meteorology and launched for World Meteorological Day 2024, disseminates weather information and forecasts. It is not an attendance, road-audit or trading app.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: On which date National Panchayati Raj Day is observed annually in India?
x: National Panchayati Raj Day is observed on 24 April, the day the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 came into force (24 April 1993); PAI 2.0 was released on 24 April 2026. 2 October is Gandhi Jayanti, not Panchayati Raj Day.

src: AP High Court Common Test for Multiple Posts 2026
s: Which festival predominantly celebrates the arrival of the Assamese New Year?
x: Bohag (Rongali) Bihu, in mid-April, marks the Assamese New Year and the arrival of spring. Magh (Bhogali) Bihu is the January harvest feast; Poila Boishakh is the Bengali New Year and Baisakhi is celebrated in Punjab.
